parks.name: Summer's Hub of Kennewick
parks.body: The one that started it. Summer's Hub opened in 2022 near Chuck E. Cheese, with Brady's Brats & Burgers as its anchor and a rotating line of trucks around it.

parks.name: Summer's Hub of Pasco
parks.body: The second Summer's Hub opened in late 2025 in the Gesa Stadium parking lot. It is built for 26 trucks, each with its own hookups, around a full indoor dining hall and restaurant.

parks.name: 1derful Food Park
parks.body: A hybrid: food trucks alongside seven small spaces with real kitchens, in the Colonnade Shopping Center between Sportsman's Warehouse and McDonald's.

parks.name: Edison Food Park
parks.body: A smaller food park from Bush Developments, built for six food trailers.

parks.name: Argyle Sun Spot Food Pavilion
parks.body: Part of the Argyle at Southridge apartments, across from Southridge High School. Trucks park outside a pavilion with indoor seating and TVs.

parks.name: Columbia Gardens
parks.address: 325 E. Columbia Gardens Way, Kennewick, WA 99336
parks.body: The Port of Kennewick's wine village on the river, off East Columbia Drive. Trucks here have included Bobablastic, Botanas Culichi, Frida's Mexican Grill and Nana's Kitchen, and each truck sets its own hours.

parks.name: Wednesdays in West
parks.address: Flat Top Park, West Richland, WA 99353
parks.geocode: 4705 W Van Giesen St, West Richland, WA 99353
parks.body: Food trucks, a community market and live music at Flat Top Park every Wednesday from May, 4:30 p.m. to dusk.

parks.name: Trucks in Richland city parks
parks.body: Richland has no permanent food truck park. The city permits trucks in its parks each season, April 1 to October 31, so spots change week to week.
